Method of Attack: Infecting victims by switching legitimate app updates with malicious payloads in man-on-the-side attacks
Abusing automatic update mechanism of victims' apps
WinDealer connects to random ChinaNet (AS4134) IP addresses from Xizang and Guizhou provinces instead of hard-coded C2 servers
WinDealer helps attackers siphon data, install backdoors, manipulate files, scan network devices, and run arbitrary commands
Attack Vector: Man-on-the-side attacks replacing app update requests for popular Asian apps (QQ, WeChat, WangWang) with malicious installers
Indicators of Compromise: Connection to random ChinaNet (AS4134) IP addresses from Xizang and Guizhou provinces
Use of a pool of 48,000 IP addresses
Targeting network traffic for app update requests linked to popular Asian apps
